selected.goal: Add focused regression coverage proving missing declared outputs invalidate stale task completion state.
selected.why_now: evidence: epoch 003 observe/findings.json identifies missing-output-cache-invalidation-coverage from the maintainer probe menu after build, compile, DAG, seed, loop-seed, run-lock, and CLI help probes all passed. Higher priorities clean based on evidence: no failing test, crash, or stalled run was observed; existing adjacent seed, DAG, and run-lock suites pass, leaving lifecycle cache invalidation as the highest-ranked unproven critical path. This is not repeated low-value cleanup because epochs 1 and 2 selected API and determinism targets, not lifecycle missing-output invalidation, and unused-import/build-warning noise is explicitly lower value.
selected.test_command: pnpm vitest run tests/playbook-loop-seed.test.ts tests/playbook-seeds.test.ts tests/playbook-run-lock.test.ts
non_goals: Do not change public CLI flags or task frontmatter schema.
Do not refactor unrelated run-lock, seed materialization, or journal code.
implementation_steps: Add a temporary-fixture regression that completes a task with a declared output, deletes that output, reruns or resumes, and asserts the task is rerun instead of accepted from stale completion state.
If the regression fails, update the bounded run completion/cache check in packages/core/src/run.ts so declared outputs are verified before treating a task as complete.
Run the mapped lifecycle and seed regression command.
acceptance_checks: pnpm vitest run tests/playbook-loop-seed.test.ts tests/playbook-seeds.test.ts tests/playbook-run-lock.test.ts
selected.rollback_plan: Revert the focused test addition and any bounded run.ts cache-validation change; no data migrations or public API changes are involved.
